option_relations.rationale: Option A describes a mixed mold infection with specific pathogens causing disseminated mucormycosis, which is a broader category that can include rhino-orbital-cerebral mucormycosis (the leaf disease) as a form of dissemination.

Option B describes a mixed fungal infection with additional Mucorales involvement, which is a broader category that can include rhino-orbital-cerebral mucormycosis (the leaf disease) as a specific manifestation.
Option C, 'Mucormycosis (Rhino-orbital-cerebral)', is clinically equivalent to the leaf disease '鼻眶脑毛霉病' (Rhino-orbital-cerebral mucormycosis).
Option D, 'Rhino-orbital-cerebral mucormycosis', is clinically equivalent to the leaf disease '鼻眶脑毛霉病' (Rhino-orbital-cerebral mucormycosis).
